description: Ranks crypto projects by a metric such as TVL, market cap, price, revenue or followers (or its 1d/7d/30d change), optionally within a category or chain, 50 per page. Sub-projects such as Aave V2 and Aave V3 rank as their own rows beside their parent. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

category.description: Only projects in the category with this slug.

chain.description: Only projects on this chain: the `chain_slug` of a row from the chains tool.

sort_order.description: desc for the highest first, asc for the lowest.

name: rank_projects
title: Project rankings
